scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Lately, it has been said that
they are developing ways to add options
to put in sockets or add statuses
on equipment that normally don't have it.
They call that ^006400Enchant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
最近听说，大家正在研究如何给装备添加插槽，或为原本没有特殊效果的装备附加属性。
这项技术被称为^006400附魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
After seeing that being developed,
I was so inspired by it
that I worked hard to discover
a way to do it and I finally
made my own way to ^006400Enchant^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看到这项技术正在开发，我深受启发，于是努力研究，终于也找到了自己的^006400附魔^000000方法！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
But in order do to this
I need some special materials.
If you're okay with it...
Do you think you can
help me out by gathering them?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
不过，要进行附魔，我需要一些特殊材料。
如果你愿意的话...能帮我把材料收集来吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I can help out!
scripts.translation: 当然，我来帮忙！

scripts.text: I'm a little busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
However, looking at you
in your current state makes me
doubt your ability to gather
the items I need...
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
不过看你现在的样子，我不太确定你能不能收齐我需要的物品...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Well, I guess if you employ
a ^006400Mercenary^000000 for this
then I think I can entrust you
with my requests... right?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
嗯...如果你雇一名^006400佣兵^000000帮忙，我想就可以把这件事托付给你了...应该吧？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to employ a Mercenary,
go find the ^006400Mercenary Guild^000000
which is by the front door of ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Go to the ^006400Information Agent^000000
and ask them where the ^006400Mercenary Guild Official^000000
is located and they will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
想雇佣佣兵的话，就去^006400佣兵公会^000000，
它就在^8B4513普隆德拉^000000正门附近。
找^006400情报员^000000，问问^006400佣兵公会职员^000000在哪里，他们会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now... Hurry and employ
a ^006400Mercenary^000000 and come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
那么...快去雇一名^006400佣兵^000000，然后回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Well since you said you're busy
I can't be helped...
When you're not so busy, come find me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
既然你说现在很忙，那我也没办法...
等你有空了，再回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You haven't gotten a mercenary yet.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你还没有雇佣佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to employ a Mercenary,
go find the ^006400Mercenary Guild^000000
which is by the front door of ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Go to the ^006400Information Agent^000000
and ask them where the ^006400Mercenary Guild Official^000000
is located and they will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
想雇佣佣兵的话，就去^006400佣兵公会^000000，
它就在^8B4513普隆德拉^000000正门附近。
找^006400情报员^000000，问问^006400佣兵公会职员^000000在哪里，他们会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now... Hurry and employ
a ^006400Mercenary^000000 and come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
那么...快去雇一名^006400佣兵^000000，然后回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Seeing you with a ^006400Mercenary^000000 definitely makes me trust you more.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看到你带着^006400佣兵^000000，我确实放心多了。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If a 006400Mercenary^000000 gives you direct effect
by fighting for you
then a ^006400Pet^000000 helps you indirectly with their
abilities and varied appearances,
and it captures your heart.
Try raising a ^006400Pet^000000 in the future as well.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果006400佣兵^000000为你战斗，就能直接提供帮助；^006400宠物^000000则会以自身能力和各具特色的外表陪伴你，给你带来别样的帮助，也会俘获你的心。
今后不妨也试着养一只^006400宠物^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, let's see... In order to
get this ^006400Enchant^000000 to succeed
you have to go gather some materials for me...
What I need is...
..............
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
我想想...要想让这次^006400附魔^000000成功，你得先替我收集一些材料...
需要的东西是...
...

scripts.text: I don't think I heard you clearly...
scripts.translation: 我好像没听清...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
I really don't like to repeat myself..
If you ask me again like that
does it just make your mouth tired?
In these situations, open your ^006400Quest Window^000000
and you can see what is requested of you
and the details of my request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
我可不喜欢重复说过的话...
你再让我说一遍，嘴巴不会累吗？
这种时候，打开^006400任务窗口^000000，就能查看需要完成的事项和委托详情。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you look at the top left
in the area with the information,
it says ^006400QUEST^000000
and if you click that
it'll show all information
that pertains to the request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
查看信息区域左上方，那里写着^006400QUEST^000000。
点击它，就能看到这项委托的所有相关信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you verify what materials
you need go gather from
the ^006400Quest Window^000000,
come find and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
在^006400任务窗口^000000确认好需要收集哪些材料后，就回来找我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You seemed to be sluggish with a lot of items
in your inventory making you heavy...
It'll be hard to do my request
when you're heavy with all that junk!
Go empty out your inventory and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你背包里东西太多，压得行动都迟钝了...
带着这么多杂物，怎么帮我办事？
清理一下背包再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems that you have
one too many items on you...
If you want to help me out
then you're gonna have to put some
stuff away then come back.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来你身上带的东西太多了...
想帮我的话，先把一些东西收起来，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Did you open your ^006400Quest Window^000000
to verify the materials?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你打开^006400任务窗口^000000确认过材料了吗？

scripts.text: Yup!
scripts.translation: 确认过了！

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 还没有...

scripts.text: Where is the Quest Window...
scripts.translation: 任务窗口在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Oh yeah? Then shall I test you to see
if you really checked it?
Write down what material I asked you to get.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
是吗？那我考考你，看看你是不是真的确认过了。
写下我让你收集的材料吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Good, you know.
Now, are you feeling pretty familiar
about the ^006400Quest Window^000000?
But there is an issue...
You know what material to collect,
but gathering that won't be easy.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
很好，看来你记住了。
现在应该熟悉^006400任务窗口^000000了吧？
不过还有个问题...你知道要收集什么，却未必那么容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Also, there is one thing
I absolutely think you need to try.
And that is...
the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
还有一件事，我觉得你一定要试试。
那就是...^006400通用银目录^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
can be obtained from
the ^0000FFCatalogue Wizard^000000
that is located in the Eden Group Headquarter.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400通用银目录^000000可以在乐园团总部
向^0000FF目录巫师^000000领取。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, go and obtain
a ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
then come back and talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
去拿一本^006400通用银目录^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You... still don't seem
to know much about the
^006400Quest Window^000000.
I will inform you again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你...看起来还是不太了解^006400任务窗口^000000。
我再说明一次。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Hurry and check to see
what materials are required in
your ^006400Quest Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
快打开你的^006400任务窗口^000000，确认需要哪些材料。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you look at the top left
in the area with the information,
it says ^006400QUEST^000000
and if you click that
it'll show all information
that pertains to the request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
查看信息区域左上方，那里写着^006400QUEST^000000。
点击它，就能看到这项委托的所有相关信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you verify what materials
you need go gather from
the ^006400Quest Window^000000,
come find and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
在^006400任务窗口^000000确认好需要收集哪些材料后，就回来找我谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Hmm? So I noticed that
you haven't gone and picked up a
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000 yet!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
嗯？我发现你还没去领^006400通用银目录^000000呢！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You can get the
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
from the ^0000FFCatalogue Wizard^000000
who is located in the Eden Group Headquarter.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400通用银目录^000000可以在乐园团总部
向^0000FF目录巫师^000000领取。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, go and get the
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
去领一本^006400通用银目录^000000，然后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Oh! You managed to get a
^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
哦！你已经拿到^006400通用银目录^000000了！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
This lets you browse and search
through all the various stores
that are on the same map and
are open for vending.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
用它可以浏览和搜索当前地图上所有正在摆摊的商店。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It only costs 200 zeny for one
of these and with it you can
search up to 10 times.
You can say that it's a necessity.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
一本只要200 Zeny，而且能搜索10次。
可以说是必备品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, go to the area you want
and try out the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
then come and find me
after you've done this.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
去你想逛的地方试用一下^006400通用银目录^000000，用过之后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Hmm... It seems that you still have
the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000 in your inventory.
Since you're saying you forgot how to use it
I'll explain it to you again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
嗯...看来你的背包里还带着^006400通用银目录^000000。
既然你说忘了怎么用，我再说明一次。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You see... the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
lets you browse and search
through all the various stores
that are on the same map and
are open for vending.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400通用银目录^000000可以让你浏览和搜索当前地图上所有正在摆摊的商店。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, go to the area you want
and try out the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
them come and find me
after you've done this.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
去你想逛的地方试用一下^006400通用银目录^000000，用过之后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
How do you feel after trying out
the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000?
It feels a lot easier than
going through each individual
vendor and finding the item
you need, right?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
用过^006400通用银目录^000000后感觉怎么样？
是不是比一家家找摊贩、再逐个搜索要买的东西方便多了？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, go out and gather
the materials I need and
I will make sure to give you
a fantastic ^006400enchant^000000!
I'll be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在去收集我需要的材料吧。
我一定会给你施加一个超棒的^006400附魔^000000！
我在这里等你！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems you didn't bring
enough materials. Did you forget
what you needed to gather?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来你带来的材料不够。
忘了要收集哪些东西吗？

scripts.text: Yeah...
scripts.translation: 是啊...

scripts.text: Nope!
scripts.translation: 没有！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
I've been told that if you click the
thing on the top left that says
^006400QUEST^000000, it'll show you all
the information that you need
that pertains to your requests.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
听说点击左上角写着^006400QUEST^000000的地方，就能查看所有与委托有关的信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you gather all the materials
that are listed in your ^006400Quest Window^000000
come and talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
收齐^006400任务窗口^000000列出的所有材料后，过来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
When you gather the items
come to me and I will show you
an awesome ^006400ENCHANT^000000.
I'll be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
收集好物品后就来找我，我会给你看看超棒的^006400附魔^000000。
我等着你！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Your inventory seems to be really full
with various stuff... Do you think
you can get anything done when you're so
weighed down? Go put some stuff away
then come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你的背包好像塞满了各种东西...带着这么多东西，行动得开吗？
先把一些东西收起来，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You seem to have too much stuff
in your inventory... Go put some
stuff away then come back to me
when you have less suff on you.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你的背包里东西太多了...先收起一部分，等身上轻便些再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
You got everything I asked for!
So~ Shall we start on the awesome
Enchant that I found and developed?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你把我要的东西都带齐了！
那么～要开始体验我研究开发的超棒附魔了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Okay! Now for the first skill!!
To add a new ability to your armor...
^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好！先来第一个技能！
为防具添加新能力...
^006400隐藏插槽附魔^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
And for the second skill!!
To add a new socket into your
weapon and shield...
^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
再来第二个技能！
为武器和盾牌添加新插槽...
^006400插槽附魔^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
There. The Enchant is done. You can't understand the process by just watching me, so I'll let you look at the items themselves.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好了，附魔完成。光看我操作，你也弄不懂其中的过程，所以我让你直接看看这些装备。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Those items cannot be
worn or traded so don't even
think about running away with them.
When you're done looking at them,
give them back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
这些装备不能穿戴，也不能交易，别想着偷偷带走。
看完后记得还给我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
What did you do with the Enchanted
items I lent to you to look at?
Until you bring back the fruits of
my labor, I don't want to talk to you,
let alone see your face.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
我借给你看的附魔装备呢？
在你把我的心血还回来之前，我不想跟你说话，更不想看见你。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Are you done looking over
the items I Enchanted?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你看完我附魔的装备了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, thank you.
scripts.translation: 看完了，谢谢。

scripts.text: I haven't looked at them yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没看呢。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So what did you think after inspecting it? Now that you've looked at an actual Enchanted item, do you understand it?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看过之后觉得怎么样？亲眼看了附魔装备，现在明白附魔是怎么回事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Thanks to you I was able to see great results of my research and study.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
多亏了你，我才能看到自己研究成果的实际效果。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you have any questions about anything that I discussed with you, I will tell you everything! Thanks for your hard work!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
刚才讲的内容有什么不明白，尽管问我，我都会为你解答！辛苦你了！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Take your time to look them over
then bring them back to me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
慢慢仔细看看，看完后再把装备还给我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
还有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: Can I do the same quest again?
scripts.translation: 我可以再做一次相同的委托吗？

scripts.text: About the Quest Window...
scripts.translation: 关于任务窗口...

scripts.text: About ENCHANT...
scripts.translation: 关于附魔...

scripts.text: About Searching Vends...
scripts.translation: 关于摆摊搜索...

scripts.text: About Mercenary and Pets...
scripts.translation: 关于佣兵和宠物...

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The one method to do the same quests repeatdedly is to do the ^006400Daily Quests^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
想重复做同一类任务，就只能接^006400每日任务^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Once you complete a ^006400Daily Quest^000000 and turn it in, wait about a day then come back to get the request and do it all over again!
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you received a daily quest, look at bottom right of the ^006400Quest Window^000000. There is a section that is called ^006400LIMITED^000000. In that section, it'll tell you how much time needs to pass before you can pick up another daily quest.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
完成并提交^006400每日任务^000000后，等上大约一天，就能回来重新接取并再做一次！
[教学指导员]
如果你接了每日任务，可以查看^006400任务窗口^000000右下角的^006400限时^000000栏目，那里会显示还要等多久才能接取下一个每日任务。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems you still have some time left to wait out after finishing my quest. Wait it out a bit more, then come find me and you can get the same quest again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来完成我的委托后，你还得再等一阵子。稍后再来找我，就能重新接到同一个委托。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It seems that about a day has passed since you've finished my quest. Alright, so like the ^006400Daily Quests^000000, you can get a quest from me. Did you want to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
看来你完成我的委托已经过了一天。好，和^006400每日任务^000000一样，现在可以再来找我接任务。要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Okay. But if you change your mind and want to receive a quest, come find me.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
好吧。改变主意、想接任务的话，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
They say that the ^006400Quest Window^000000 details out everything you need to know about your quests.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
听说^006400任务窗口^000000会详细列出你需要了解的任务信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you look at the top left
in the area with the information,
it says ^006400QUEST^000000
and if you click that
it'll show all information
that pertains to the request.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
查看信息区域左上方，那里写着^006400QUEST^000000。
点击它，就能看到这项委托的所有相关信息。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Using the ^006400Quest Window^000000 will make your life easier. It'll tell you where to go, what items to get or who to find and etc.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
善用^006400任务窗口^000000会轻松很多。它会告诉你该去哪里、要拿什么物品、该找谁等等。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
^006400ENCHANT^000000, in general, is divided into two parts: ^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 and ^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000.

[Tutorial Instructor]
^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 is used to add a SOCKET into equipments and ^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 is used to put in stats into a socket of an armor.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400插槽附魔^000000用于给装备添加插槽；^006400隐藏插槽附魔^000000则是在防具的插槽中附加属性。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Of course, in order to do this we are in need of some materials and there is a chance that it may fail, but that's the risk you're taking.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
当然，附魔需要材料，也有失败的可能。这就是你要承担的风险。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The people who do the ^006400SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 can be found in ^8B4513Prontera, Morocc, Payon,^000000. ^8B4513Rhitalzen^000000 is in the Refinery and ^0000FFSeiyablem^000000 and ^0000FFReiablem^000000 can be found near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
进行^006400插槽附魔^000000的人在^8B4513普隆德拉、梦罗克、斐扬^000000都能找到。^8B4513瑞塔尔岑^000000的精炼厂里也有一位，入口附近则有^0000FF赛亚布雷姆^000000和^0000FF雷亚布雷姆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The one who does ^006400HIDDEN SOCKET ENCHANT^000000 is found at the 6 o'clock location of ^8B4513Prontera^000000. Look for the ^0000FFCraftman Apprentice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
负责^006400隐藏插槽附魔^000000的人在^8B4513普隆德拉^000000的六点钟方向，找^0000FF工匠学徒^000000就行。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Do you think you understand a little bit more about ^006400ENCHANT^000000?
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
你觉得自己对^006400附魔^000000了解得更多了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
^006400Vend Search^000000 can be utilized by the ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000 item. Since you search through as vends on that map, it'll make it easier for you to find the item that you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
使用^006400通用银目录^000000道具就能进行^006400摆摊搜索^000000。它会搜索当前地图上的摊位，让你更容易找到想买的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
The ^006400Universal Silver Catalog^000000
can be obtained from 
the ^0000FFCatalogue Wizard^000000
that is located in the Eden Group Headquarter.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
^006400通用银目录^000000可以在乐园团总部
向^0000FF目录巫师^000000领取。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
It only costs 200 zeny for one
of these and with it you can
search up to 10 times.
You can say that it's a necessity.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
一本只要200 Zeny，而且能搜索10次。
可以说是必备品。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
So, are you getting familiar with ^006400Vend Search^000000? Don't just stand there and listen to me. Go ahead and try it for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在熟悉^006400摆摊搜索^000000了吗？别光站着听我讲，自己去试试看吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Depending on what you need, ^006400Mercenary^000000 and ^006400Pet^000000 can be used in various ways.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
根据不同需求，^006400佣兵^000000和^006400宠物^000000都能派上不同用场。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If a 006400Mercenary^000000 gives you direct effect
by fighting for you
then a ^006400Pet^000000 helps you indirectly with their
abilities and varied appearances,
and it captures your heart.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
如果006400佣兵^000000为你战斗，就能直接提供帮助；^006400宠物^000000则会以自身能力和各具特色的外表陪伴你，给你带来别样的帮助，也会俘获你的心。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to employ a Mercenary
Go find the ^006400Mercenary Guild^000000
which is by the front door of ^8B4513Prontera^000000.
Go to the ^006400Information Agent^000000
and ask them where the ^006400Mercenary Guild Official^000000
is located and they will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
要雇佣佣兵，去找^006400佣兵公会^000000，公会就在^8B4513普隆德拉^000000正门附近。
找^006400情报员^000000打听^006400佣兵公会职员^000000的位置，他们会告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
In order to get a ^006400Pet^000000, while hunting you will obtain taming items. Use the tame on the monster it's for and you can get a pet.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
想获得^006400宠物^000000，打怪时可以收集驯服道具。对对应的魔物使用道具，就有机会收服它成为宠物。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Because there is a chance for failure, please use the taming item with great care.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
驯服可能失败，使用驯服道具时请多加小心。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
That aside... you can get a ^006400Mercenary^000000 from the Mercenary Guild and you can get a ^006400Pet^000000 by trading or buying it from another player.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
除此之外...你可以从佣兵公会雇佣^006400佣兵^000000，或通过交易、向其他玩家购买来获得^006400宠物^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Now, do you understand a bit more about using a ^006400Mercenary^000000 and a ^006400Pet^000000? I hope you get a chance to use them in the future.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
现在你对如何使用^006400佣兵^000000和^006400宠物^000000了解多一些了吗？希望以后你有机会用上它们。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
If you have any questions, come find me again.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
有问题的话，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Instructor]
Lately, it has been said that
they are developing ways to add options
to put in sockets or add statuses
on equipment that normally don't have it.
scripts.translation:
[教学指导员]
最近听说，大家正在研究如何给装备添加插槽，或为原本没有特殊效果的装备附加属性。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You seem to be overweight with items. Go put some stuff away then come back.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你身上带的东西太重了。先收起一部分，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You have too many items on you. Go put some stuff away then come back.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你身上带的东西太多了。先收起一些，再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Well~ We gotta go challenge the experts right?
Let's start off by finding the ^006400Siege Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
嗯～我们得去挑战那些专家，对吧？
先去找^006400攻城战专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You've passed the ^006400Siege Expert^000000's test! Congrats!
Now, go find the ^006400Party Recruiting Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你通过了^006400攻城战专家^000000的考验！恭喜！
接下来去找^006400组队招募专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Oh! You've passed the ^006400Party Recruiting Expert^000000's test! Congrats!
Now, go find the ^006400Battleground Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
哦！你通过了^006400组队招募专家^000000的考验！恭喜！
接下来去找^006400战场专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Yay! You passed the test from the ^006400Battleground Expert^000000! Congrats!
Next, go and find the ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
太棒了！你通过了^006400战场专家^000000的考验！恭喜！
接下来去找^006400纪念迷宫专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You passed the test from ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000! That's great!
Try finding the ^006400Map Expert^000000!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
你通过了^006400纪念迷宫专家^000000的考验！真不错！
再去找找^006400地图专家^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You passed ^006400Map Expert^000000's test! Congrats!
I'm so glad that you were to pass all the Experts' tests! You're better than I expected!!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
恭喜你通过了^006400地图专家^000000的考验！
你通过了所有专家的考验，真让人高兴！你比我预想的厉害多了！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Now, even you are an ^006400Expert^000000!! Such a fitting nick name for you!
Thank you so much for your hard work. As promised, here is a small little reward for you.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
现在你也成了^006400专家^000000！这个称号真适合你！
辛苦你了。说好的，这是给你的一点奖励。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
I think it'll be useful to you during your adventures. I wish you luck on your future adventures~
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
这东西在你的冒险中应该派得上用场。祝你今后的冒险一路顺利～

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Now, even you are an ^006400Expert^000000!! Such a fitting nick name for you!
Thank you so much for your hard work.
I hope that your future adventures are filled with good luck.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
现在你也成了^006400专家^000000！这个称号真适合你！
辛苦你了。
祝你今后的冒险好运连连。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Hmm, I wonder if there is any adventurer that is smart enough to challenge our Experts...
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
嗯...不知道有没有足够聪明的冒险者，敢来挑战我们的专家...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Hey you! You look like an adventurer... Though you look a little dull...
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
喂，你！看着像个冒险者...不过好像不太机灵...

scripts.text: What'd you say? I'm smart!
scripts.translation: 你说什么？我可聪明了！

scripts.text: Yeah... I'm dull.
scripts.translation: 是啊...我是不太机灵。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Serious? Though I don't know if I can believe that. Look at the expert who is in front of me! He took up only one area of study for 16 years and now he is as dignified as can be!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
当真？我可不太信。看看我面前这位专家！他花了16年只钻研一个领域，如今可是威风得很！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Well, if you manage to pass all their tests then I will believe in your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
这样吧，你要是能通过他们所有人的考验，我就相信你有本事。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
And I will apologize for calling you dull. How about it, Dull Expert?! Do you want to challenge them?
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
到时候我还会为说你不机灵而道歉。怎么样，迟钝专家？！敢不敢挑战他们？

scripts.text: Ch... Challenge!!
Um... I think I'll just give up now...
scripts.translation: 呃...我还是现在就放弃吧...

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
You're braver than you look. You can't go back now that you've decided to challenge!
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
看不出来你还挺勇敢。既然决定挑战了，可就不能反悔！

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Okay~ Start by talking to the ^006400Siege Expert^000000 who's right there in front.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
好～先和面前这位^006400攻城战专家^000000聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Tutorial Goal]
Well, don't get discouraged... If you change your mind and want to do the challenge, come find me.
scripts.translation:
[教学目标]
别灰心...改变主意、想接受挑战的话，就回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
Since you've come again, I assume you're curious about ^006400Siege^000000?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
你又来了，看来是对^006400攻城战^000000感兴趣？

scripts.text: Listen about Siege.
scripts.translation: 听听攻城战的介绍

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
A ^006400Siege^000000 is a ^0000FFGuild vs. Guild^000000 war in hope to occupy a castle!
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
^006400攻城战^000000是^0000FF公会对公会^000000的战争，目标是占领城堡！

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
There are 2 different types of ^006400Siege^000000.
There is the standard ^006400War of Emperium^000000 and one that is slightly different which is known as ^006400War of Emperium 2^000000.

[Siege Expert]
So during this time, there are two sides of the war.
The ^0000FFGuild That Owns a Castle^000000 tries to protect the ^006400Emperium^000000 and the ^0000FFGuild That Attacks a Castle^000000 tries to break the ^006400Emperium^000000.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
攻城战期间，双方各有目标：^0000FF城堡的所有公会^000000要保护^006400华丽金属^000000，^0000FF进攻城堡的公会^000000则要摧毁^006400华丽金属^000000。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
You can find ^006400Siege^000000 times on our website.
And guilds that win also get a special something-something.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
你可以在我们的网站上查看^006400攻城战^000000的开放时间。获胜的公会还能得到特别奖励。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
Guilds that win during the Siege
get access to a ^006400Guild Dungeon^000000
and the Guild Master gets to open ^006400Treasure Box^000000es at ^0000FFMidnight each day^000000.
Isn't that a great benefit?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
攻城战获胜的公会可以进入^006400公会地下城^000000，
公会会长还可以开启^006400宝箱^000000，
每天^0000FF午夜^000000都能开启一次。
这福利不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
Another thing you have to do when you win a castle is called ^006400Commerce Development^000000. The more you do it, the better the benefits.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
占领城堡后还要进行一项叫作^006400商业发展^000000的工作。投入越多，收益越好。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
Now that you've gone through all of this with an expert, isn't it easy to understand? If you want to go over anything, just come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
你已经听专家讲过这些内容了，应该更容易理解了吧？想复习哪部分，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
If you want to go over anything, just come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
想复习的话，随时来找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
I am someone who has studied War of Emperium for 16 years! So that makes me an expert! Since you came to find me, I assume you want to learn more about ^006400Siege^000000.
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
我研究攻城战已经16年了，所以我才是专家！既然你特地来找我，想必是想多了解一些^006400攻城战^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
You have great desire and enthusiasm. As the Expert of ^006400Siege^000000, you have motivated me! All the other Experts are waiting for you! Go get'em!
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
你的热情和求知欲真不错。身为^006400攻城战^000000专家，我都被你感染了！其他专家也在等你，快去挑战他们吧！

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
If I told you that there was a great prize for being able to pass all the Experts' tests~ would you go for the challenge?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
如果我说，通过所有专家的考验就能得到丰厚奖励...你愿意接受挑战吗？

scripts.text:
[Siege Expert]
As the first Expert, I can teach you about ^006400Siege^000000. How about it? Did you wanna learn about ^006400Siege^000000s?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
作为第一位专家，我可以教你^006400攻城战^000000。怎么样？想了解一下^006400攻城战^000000吗？

scripts.text: Listen about Siege.
scripts.translation: 听听攻城战的介绍

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

[Siege Expert]
Now that you've gone through all of this with an expert, isn't it easy to understand?
Now I'll give you 3 questions~ get those right and you've passed! Do you want a challenge?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
既然你已经听专家讲过这些内容，理解起来应该容易多了吧？
现在我来问你3个问题～答对就算通过！要接受挑战吗？

scripts.text: Challenge me!
scripts.translation: 我接受挑战！

What words go in the empty spaces of []?

What is the wrong Siege time?
scripts.translation:
[攻城战专家]
以下哪项攻城战时间安排有误？

scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]

[Party Recruiting Expert]

scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
But if you want to retake the quiz! Go for it! I think you have potential! Wanna take the quiz again?
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
想重新挑战的话就再试一次吧！我觉得你很有潜力。要再测一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
^006400Party Recruiting^000000 is pretty self explanatory. It helps people find party members and it helps people find parties.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
^006400组队招募^000000顾名思义，就是帮助玩家寻找队伍，或为队伍招募成员。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
There are 2 parts to Party Recruiting.
1st step is ^0000FFRegistering Party Recruiting^000000,
and the 2nd step is ^0000FFParty Search^000000.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
组队招募分为两步：
第一步是^0000FF发布组队招募信息^000000，第二步是^0000FF搜索队伍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
In order to look up Party Recruiting, in the info window on the upper left, click the button that says ^006400booking^000000. Then the ^006400Party Recruiting List^000000 will come up.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
想查找招募信息，点击左上方信息窗口里的^006400预约^000000按钮，就会打开^006400组队招募列表^000000。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
^006400Party Recruiting List^000000 window shows you the parties that are looking for members that was listed by other users. You can search through it.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
^006400组队招募列表^000000会显示其他玩家发布的招募信息，也可以在其中搜索。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
In the case that you don't want to join a party, but you want to recruit for one, type in the ^0000FF/Party Recruit^000000 command then in the ^006400Party Recruiting^000000 window, you can do some recruiting!
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
如果你不想加入队伍，而是想为自己的队伍招人，就输入^0000FF/Party Recruit^000000命令，然后在^006400组队招募^000000窗口发布信息。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
Once you register your party recruit notice in the ^006400Party Recruiting^000000 window, the users can search out your ^006400Party Recruiting List^000000
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
在^006400组队招募^000000窗口发布招募信息后，其他玩家就能在^006400组队招募列表^000000中找到你的队伍。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
In the ^006400Party Recruiting List^000000 and
^006400Party Recruiting^000000 you can put in basic information of what you're going to be doing, or what you're looking for like 
^006400LEVEL^000000, ^006400MAP^000000, ^006400JOB^000000.
Then the users can search using those parameters and utilizing the ^006400Party Recruitment^000000 system.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
在^006400组队招募列表^000000和^006400组队招募^000000窗口中，可以填写活动内容或招募要求等基本信息，例如^006400等级^000000、^006400地图^000000和^006400职业^000000。
其他玩家就能按这些条件搜索，使用^006400组队招募^000000系统找到合适的队伍。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
If you want to learn more commands about ^006400Party Recruiting^000000, click on the ^006400Help^000000 button on the bottom right of the ^006400Party Recruiting list^000000.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
想了解更多^006400组队招募^000000命令，请点击^006400组队招募列表^000000右下角的^006400帮助^000000按钮。

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
Now~ my explanations were smoother than a smooth criminal, right? Now I'm gonna give you a quiz with 3 questions. Get them all right and you've passed. Wanna take the challenge?
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
怎么样～我的讲解是不是流畅得像Smooth Criminal一样？接下来我要出3道题，全部答对就算通过。要挑战一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
Don't give up! You can do it! If you change your mind, come talk to me again!
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
别放弃！你一定行！改变主意的话，再来找我聊聊！

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
You're gonna give up without even listening to me? If you change your mind, come talk to me again!
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
还没听我讲就要放弃吗？改变主意的话，再来找我聊聊！

scripts.text:
[Party Recruiting Expert]
If you want to learn something from me, talk to the ^006400Siege Master^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[组队招募专家]
想跟我学东西的话，先去找^006400攻城战大师^000000。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
Seeing that you sought me out, I guess you want to learn about ^006400Battleground^000000s, eh?
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
你特意来找我，看来是想了解^006400战场^000000吧？

scripts.text: Learn about Battlegrounds.
scripts.translation: 了解战场

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
To explain ^006400Battleground^000000 easily...
You pick either Camp ^006400Guillaume^000000 or Camp ^006400Croix^000000 then you fight each other.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
简单来说，参加^006400战场^000000时，你要选择^006400吉约姆^000000或^006400克罗瓦^000000阵营，然后与对方交战。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
There are 3 types of ^006400Battleground^000000s.
First is ^006400KVM^000000. It is a 5vs5 battle with the goal of reducing the number of people on either side.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
^006400战场^000000有三种。第一种是^006400KVM^000000，采用5对5的形式，目标是击败尽可能多的敌方队员。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
The second one is 10vs10. You attack the supply depots of your opponents and in turn, you protect your supply depots. This is called ^006400Tierra^000000.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
第二种是10对10，名为^006400Tierra^000000。你要攻击敌方补给仓库，同时保护己方仓库。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
The third and final one is called ^006400Flavius^000000. This one is also 10vs10. For this one, you attack the crystals of your opponents while trying to protect your own.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
第三种也是最后一种叫作^006400Flavius^000000，采用10对10的形式。你要攻击敌方水晶，同时保护己方水晶。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
To get to ^006400Battleground^000000s, find ^006400Maroll, the Recruiter^000000 who can be found in all major towns.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
想进入^006400战场^000000，去主要城镇寻找^006400招募员马罗尔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
After you enter, pick if you want to side with Guillaume or Croix, then on their side, pick either...
^006400KVM Mercenary Recruiter^000000,
^006400Tierra Mercenary Recruiter^000000, or
^006400Flavius Mercenary Recruiter^000000,
then you can join the ^006400Battleground^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
进入战场后，先选择吉约姆或克罗瓦阵营，再从本阵营的招募员中选择一位：
^006400KVM佣兵招募员^000000、
^006400Tierra佣兵招募员^000000或
^006400Flavius佣兵招募员^000000。
之后就能加入^006400战场^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
Depending on the outcome of the ^006400Battleground^000000 you can get a prize too.
You get KVM Badges from ^006400KVM^000000,
from ^006400Tierra^000000 you obtain Bravery Badges and
you receive Valor Badges ^006400Flavius^000000.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
根据^006400战场^000000的结果，你还能获得奖励。
参加^006400KVM^000000可获得KVM徽章，参加^006400Tierra^000000可获得勇猛徽章，参加^006400Flavius^000000则可获得英勇徽章。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
With the rewards from ^006400Battleground^000000s, you can get items that you can't normally get elsewhere.
Each ^006400Battleground^000000 reward you can obtain is different so you'll have to check on it.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
通过^006400战场^000000奖励，你还能兑换其他地方无法获得的物品。
不同^006400战场^000000的奖励各不相同，记得确认清楚。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
There's nothing better than hearing it straight from the expert! If you want to go over it again, just talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
没什么比直接听专家讲解更好了！想复习的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]
If you want to go over anything, let me know.
scripts.translation:

想复习什么内容，尽管告诉我。

For 16 years, I experienced the intense heat of battle on the ^006400Battleground^000000s... I am the ^006400Battleground^000000 Expert!

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

You may already know but if you get pass all the quizzes from the Experts, you'll get a prize!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]

scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
^006400战场^000000有三种。第一种是^006400KVM^000000，采用5对5的形式，目标是击败尽可能多的敌方队员。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]

scripts.translation:
[战场专家]
第二种是10对10，名为^006400Tierra^000000。你要攻击敌方补给仓库，同时保护己方仓库。

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]

scripts.translation:
[战场专家]

scripts.text:
[Battleground Expert]

^006400Tierra Mercenary Recruiter^000000, or
^006400Flavius Mercenary Recruiter^000000,

^006400KVM佣兵招募员^000000、
^006400Tierra佣兵招募员^000000或
^006400Flavius佣兵招募员^000000。

[Battleground Expert]

另外，完成一次记忆地下城后，需要等待一段时间才能再次进入同一个^006400记忆地下城^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Many ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000s exist, but we will give you hints to help you find Memorial Dungeon in the world of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
米德加尔特有许多^006400记忆地下城^000000。我们会给你一些线索，告诉你该去哪里找。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
First, go to ^8B4513Alberta^000000 and find ^006400Captain Jansen^000000.
He will give you information about the really huge and tall dungeon known as ^006400Endless Tower^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
首先，前往^8B4513艾尔贝塔^000000找^006400詹森船长^000000。
他会告诉你那座高耸巨大的迷宫——^006400无尽之塔^000000的相关情报。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Second, go to the ^8B4513Orc Map^000000 where all the orcs live and find the ^006400Insane Scientist^000000.
You might be able to get some information about a dungeon that has to do with ^006400Orc's Memory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
其次，前往^8B4513兽人地图^000000，找到^006400癫狂科学家^000000。
他或许能提供与^006400兽人记忆^000000有关的地下城情报。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Third and last, seek out the place where you can become a monk, which is the ^8B4513Capitolina Monastery^000000 and seek out ^006400Detective Patrick^000000.
He will be able to give you information about the dungeon with the ^006400Sealed Baphomet^000000+.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
最后，前往武僧修行之地^8B4513圣卡波利纳修道院^000000，寻找^006400侦探帕特里克^000000。
他会告诉你封印着^006400巴风特^000000的地下城的情报+。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Of course there are other locations for Memorial Dungeon but it's best to start where you can find it easily.
As you continue to go on your adventures you will be able to find them more easily.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
当然，记忆地下城还有其他地点，不过最好先从容易找到的地方开始。
随着冒险经验增加，你会越来越容易发现它们。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
It's easy to understand since it's coming from an expert like me. Now it's quiz time. You have to get all the answers correct to pass. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
由我这位专家来讲解，内容应该很好理解。现在开始测验，全部答对才能通过。准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Giving up is lame. If you change your mind, come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
放弃可不太体面。改变主意的话，再来找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
Giving up without even trying is lame. If you change your mind, come talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
还没试就放弃可不太体面。改变主意的话，再来找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Memorial Dungeon Expert]
If you want to learn anything from me, talk to the ^006400Battleground Master^000000 first and get acknowledged by him.
scripts.translation:
[记忆地下城专家]
想向我请教的话，先去找^006400战场大师^000000并获得他的认可。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Seeing that you came to me, I assume you have some questions about ^006400MAP^000000s?
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
你特地来找我，想必是想了解^006400地图^000000吧？

scripts.text: List about the Map.
scripts.translation: 查看地图列表

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
A ^006400MAP^000000 shows you things that is much needed for travelling around the world; such as the lay of the land, major towns and fields and such. It's a very important tool!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
^006400地图^000000会显示你在世界各地旅行时需要的信息，例如地形、主要城镇和原野等，是非常重要的工具！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Because of this, it's more important than everything else that you know about ^006400MAP^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
正因如此，了解^006400地图^000000比其他事情都重要。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
The map can be accessed by clicking on the button that says ^006400MAP^000000 on the upper left side of your screen.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
点击屏幕左上角标有^006400地图^000000的按钮，就能打开地图。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
When you click on the ^006400MAP^000000 button, a full sized map of Midgard will take up your screen.
When you ^0000FFHover your mouse over specific areas^000000, you can find out more things such as ^006400NAME^000000 and Area Details.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
点击^006400地图^000000按钮后，米德加尔特的完整地图就会显示在屏幕上。
把鼠标^0000FF悬停在特定区域^000000上，还能查看^006400名称^000000和区域详情等信息。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you look to the lower right side of your map, there is a ^006400Poring drawing^000000.
If you click on it or press the ^006400TAB^000000 shortcut key, you will be able to various information.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
地图右下方有一个^006400波利图标^000000。
点击图标或按^006400TAB^000000键，就能查看各种信息。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Firstly, you can find out the ^006400NAME^000000 and ^006400LEVEL^000000 of the monsters in each area. That will take a lot of the guess work out of where you want to go hunt.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
首先，你能查看各区域魔物的^006400名称^000000和^006400等级^000000，方便判断该去哪里狩猎。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Secondly, You can locate various ^006400DUNGEON^000000s and their
^006400Entrance Location^000000. Plus, it'll also tell you monsters that reside in that area
along with their ^006400LEVEL^000000. It's displayed in red so it's easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
其次，你可以查找各个^006400地下城^000000及其^006400入口位置^000000。地图还会列出该区域的魔物和它们的^006400等级^000000，相关信息会以红色标出，方便查看。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you want to stop looking at the map, there are 2 ways to do this.
You can press the shortcut keys which are ^006400CTRL + %^000000 or ^006400ESC^000000
Or at the top right of the map, there is a ^006400X^000000 button. Click that and you will return to your normal game screen.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
关闭地图有两种方法：按快捷键^006400CTRL + %^000000或^006400ESC^000000；也可以点击地图右上角的^006400X^000000按钮，返回游戏画面。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
Currently, we cannot see places that are beyond Midgard but it has been said that there are a lot of unknown worlds that exist in the beyond.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
目前我们还看不到米德加尔特以外的地方，不过听说远方还有许多未知世界。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you end up in those areas while you're adventuring, be sure to tell me all about it!
And now, since you've passed all the Expert's quizzes, go on and talk to ^006400Tutorial Goal^000000.
scripts.translation:

冒险时要是去了那些地方，记得回来告诉我！
现在你已经通过了所有专家的测验，去找^006400教学目标^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you have any more questions, come find me.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
还有问题的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
I have been researching and studying ^006400MAP^000000s for 16 years and so now I am the ^006400MAP^000000 Expert!
Since you've sought me out, it seems you've passed ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000's quiz.
scripts.translation:

我研究^006400地图^000000已经16年了，所以现在是^006400地图^000000专家！
既然你来找我，看来已经通过^006400记忆地下城专家^000000的测验了。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
As you already know, if you pass all the Experts' quiz you'll get a prize.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
你应该已经知道，通过所有专家的测验就能获得奖励。

As the last Expert, I will try to explain everything about ^006400MAP^000000s to make it easy on you. Ready to start?

Currently, we cannot see places that are beyond Midgard but it has been said that there are a lot of unknown worlds that exist in the beyond.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
目前我们还看不到米德加尔特以外的地方，不过听说远方还有许多未知世界。

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
How is this Expert's explanations? Now I am gonna give you a quick quiz. You have to get all the answers correct to pass. Want to try it?
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
我的讲解怎么样？接下来给你出几道小测验，全部答对才能通过。想试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
I'm the last Expert! Dont' give up! Come find me again when you're ready!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
我是最后一位专家！别放弃！准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
You're gonna give up without even trying? But I'm the last Expert! Dont' give up! Come find me again when you're ready!
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
还没试就要放弃吗？我可是最后一位专家！别放弃，准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Map Expert]
If you want to learn from me, go get acknowledged by the ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[地图专家]
想跟我学习的话，先去获得^006400记忆地下城^000000的认可。
